title: Ischgl Full Catalog Curation - normalized model migration
summary: Migrates PR #12 onto the normalized Snowcast catalog and incorporates the source-review corrections. Facts are assigned to explicit regions, stay destinations, stay bases, ski areas, access edges, pass products, and rental facts. The review update adds current Winter 2026/27 pass tariffs, preserves ski routes outside the piste-difficulty buckets, corrects skill-fit evidence, sources the village type and representative base elevation, and records the nearest-lift OSM provenance and derived distance.

unresolved_caveats: The official 239 km terrain total includes 15 km of separately categorized ski routes; the report documents the published 47/140/37 km easy/medium/difficult piste figures, while the catalog leaves the split unresolved rather than forcing those routes into advanced pistes.
